words: The pink slide rule only applies in this case: Price has rejected the pink three times on the way down. And pink is in the bottom/top 33% of the channel. Only then are longs/shorts blocked. If price has not rejected the pink three times, the slide does not apply. If price is not in the bottom 33%, the slide does not apply. The inverse is true for shorts: Three rejections off the pink on the way up. And pink in the top 33% of the channel. Only then are shorts blocked. In every other case the slide rule does nothing. ... i did not ask for pink slide off. i asked for it to be revised. i gave instructions as to what i want. please do that.
